about: A / in JS or TS starts a regex literal or divides, by the token before it. A tokenizer that guesses division where a regex starts reads a regex's \/ and closing / as //, takes the rest of the line for a comment, and a lint reading the code drops what is written there. The rule: after the ) of an if, while, for or with head, a / starts a regex; after any other ), after ], ++, --, a word, a number, a string, a template or a regex, it divides (after a postfix ++ or -- the expression is complete, and a prefix one cannot take a regex); after (, [, a comma, an operator, ;, :, {, the } of a block, or a keyword such as return or typeof, it starts a regex. Where the tokenizer cannot decide (a ) or } whose opener it has not seen or cannot classify), it scans both readings and keeps the union of what each reads as code, so it fails closed.
rows: each source, as a whole file read as TSX (a .tsx file: TypeScript with JSX), and whether the unsafe text after the slash is code (hit) or a comment.

unresolved: a row with "unresolved": true has a token one lookahead cannot classify (a / or a < after a ) or } whose opener is unseen: a regex or a division, a JSX tag or a comparison). A lexer must not guess there: it scans both readings and reports their union (hit is that union), or reports the case as unresolved, which fails closed. Generated cases over undecided_before follow the same convention. A < starts a JSX tag only where an expression can start and the name after it is not followed by extends, = or , (those are type parameters: <T extends U>, <T = V>, <T,>).

generate: regex_line over regex_before and undecided_before x bodies is always a hit; division_line over division_before is never one, and over undecided_before always one (the union). Run by manaflow-ai/cmux-platform test/node/no-guessable-temp-names.test.ts; written so any other hand-rolled JS tokenizer (manaflow-ai/cmux scripts/check-test-determinism.py) can run it as is, where a case its lexer reports as unresolved counts as failing closed.

This file is shared by byte (other repos pin its sha256): after an edit, run `vp fmt test/node/fixtures/regex-after-token.json` in manaflow-ai/cmux-platform; a test fails a table written any other way.

ranges: where TypeScript's parser (the typescript package's, reading the source as a .tsx file) puts each comment, string, regex, template and jsx_text in a source, as [kind, start, end) with start and end in UTF-16 code units. Every source is in the BMP, so they are Python str indices too; a source that starts with a byte order mark (U+FEFF) counts it as offset 0. A template range is one piece of a template literal: `...${, }...${ or }...` (a template without holes is one piece). A row the parser reports a syntax error in has "syntax_error": true and no ranges.

parsed: cases test/node/regex-table.ts writes (`node test/node/regex-table.ts` in manaflow-ai/cmux-platform) from fixed families (asi, jsx_generics, jsx_tags, jsx_keyword_attrs, shebang_bom, lookahead_comments, unicode, postfix_bang, templates, identifiers, generate) and a seeded mutation of each (family_mutated: one space made another white space, or a comment or line break put beside it). Each source parses with no syntax error, and hit is whether /tmp/out.$$ occurs outside every comment range. A re-run writes the same bytes; a test fails a table that differs from what it writes.
